questions.content: Let N denote the set of all natural numbers. Define two binary relations on N as R = {(x, y) N N : 2x + y = 10} and R2 = {(x, y) N N : x + 2y = 10}. Then :

options.content: Both R<sub>1</sub> and R<sub>2</sub> are symmetric relations.
Both R<sub>1</sub> and R<sub>2</sub> are transitive relations.
